headline: Creative Eye announces outcome of board meeting
hook: Routine board meeting update from Creative Eye
summary: Creative Eye has announced the outcome of its board meeting held on October 22, 2026. Procedural disclosures like this are standard compliance updates for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding the stock should review the filing details on the exchange. The update carries limited financial impact on broader market indices.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on share value.
